messages:
Maria: Heads-up — BigCorp asked for an immediate sticky routing override to their Dedicated pool for compliance reasons. Filing: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345. They want traffic pinned until 2026-05-01 or until we revoke.
Ken: Do we have an approved workflow for per-org sticky overrides? We have escape hatches but not a self-serve with audit + TTL.
Jules: We should require: approver id, explicit TTL, business reason, and an audit event. Console UX: modal flow + preview + impact estimate. No permanent allowlists. :no_entry:  
Alex: Runtime concern — sticky routing mustn’t break rolling deployments or autoscaling. Proposal: accept a signed override header that the gateway validates and then pins routing for matching session/keys. Example header:
```
x-rw-override: org=bigcorp;pool=dedicated-east-1;expires=1769999999;sig=BASE64HMAC
```
Ken: Signed header means KMS/HMAC keys + rotation. Also need DB record so console shows who added it and when. No ad-hoc raw headers from customers.
Li: Security note: signed tokens are ok if short-lived and issued by control plane. Long-lived HMACs are a risk. Prefer issuing a signed override JWT with claims {org, pool, exp, nonce, issued_by}. Control plane should mint with a 30d max TTL and require approved workflows for >7d.
Deploy-bot: INF-2345 moved to "in review" by @Ken.
SRE-Oncall: Telemetry: add route.override=true dimension and emit sample traces for pinned sessions. We also need a fallback metric for expired overrides routing to fallback pools.
Jules: UX follow-ups: 1) modal must show sample percent of traffic affected, 2) checkbox to "auto-revert at TTL", 3) link to audit trail. Preview should show example request headers and what the gateway will do.
Maria: Also pricing/billing: BigCorp expects reserved capacity pricing, but they asked for override before contract date. Do not auto-exempt their quota; map traffic to their dedicated quota + bill as usual.
Ken: Agree. Implementation plan: 1) control-plane endpoint to create override records (approver + reason + TTL), 2) issue short-lived signed token, 3) gateway validates token and sets sticky mapping in routing table with expiry, 4) emit audit event + telemetry.
Alex: I'll prototype gateway validation + sticky mapping. Edge-case: what happens to in-flight KV caches if route switches? propose per-session KV namespace keyed by org so caches don't collide.
Li: Security review required for token format and key rotation. Recommend HSM-backed signing and per-region key sets. Also require approver SSO identity in the audit event.
SRE-Oncall: We should add a canary rollout for this feature behind a feature flag and run chaos tests that kill the dedicated pool and ensure fallback to normal routing works. Also verify no packet loss during TTL expiry.
Jules: Console: add "temporary overrides" view with filters (org, approver, status, expires) and an action to revoke + audit comment. Audit events must be immutable and exportable.
Maria: Short-term: can we do a manual DB flag to satisfy the customer for 48h while we build the proper flow? If yes, I need owners and timelines.
Ken: I can stand up an admin-only flag in the control plane DB and wire a simple gateway check — needs SRE signoff for safety. Will aim for a 48h hotfix if SRE is ok.
SRE-Oncall: I'll scope the safety tests and approve if we have immediate monitoring + an automatic revert task at 48h.
Alex: I'll add unit + integration tests for header parsing and TTL enforcement. Will open a PR and link to INF-2345.
Li: I'll schedule a quick security review slot tomorrow.
Jules: UX owners: I’ll draft the modal copy and preview mock in Figma, will share a prototype link in the thread.
Maria: Thanks — please @mention me on PRs and the hotfix. Tagging @CTO for visibility. :eyes: 
CTO: Noted. Appreciate the caution — prioritize auditability and automatic reversion. Keep me posted on timelines.
